column2: So you're going with Akira-kun?
So you're going with Honey?
Teams all set! So then, uhh...
This place is apparently called the "Hill of Beginnings." Once we've each done what we came for, we all meet back at the "Hill of Beginnings"!
Well then, let's go, Akira-kun!
Y-yeah. Well, see you all later!
Well then, shall we go?
Wh-whoa, an earthquake!
Kyaaa!!
...The path's blocked off! We can't get back to the "Hill of Beginnings"!
What a pickle... Anyway, let's hurry on. Once we're down the mountain, I'm sure there'll be another way back.
B-but seriously, all this "go right," "go left"... How do they even know where we are?
L-like I said, how do they know where we...
This is no time to argue! It's the only lead we've got!
Ryo said to take the left path... This isn't it.
Papa said the right path leads to the laboratory. This isn't it.
First I've got to find Ryo... Let's go into the house.
Papa's in danger! Let's hurry to the laboratory!
How strange... Why would Papa's laboratory be in a place like this...?
{!R}Honey, come quickly, Honey!{!W}
Why can I hear Papa's voice?
{!R}Your earrings are a transceiver, Honey. Hurry! Panther Claw is after me!{!W}
Panther Claw?
{!R}A terrifying enemy! My life is in danger! Hurry, Honey!{!W}
Oh no! I've got to save Papa!
What do you think you're doing!?
Kyaaa!
{!R}Don't worry, Honey. Pinch the heart at your throat and shout "Honey Flash!"{!W}
Pinch the heart?\n\nHoney... FLASH!
Wh-what am I...?
Papa, what am I, really? Why do I have this power? Answer me, Papa...!
I have to hurry... Papa's in danger!
Papa!
Her papa? Oh no!
Honey... My Honey...
Papaaa!
{!R}Don't be alarmed, Honey.{!W}
{!R}I am dead.\n\nBut even in death, there is something I must tell you! Honey's secret!{!W}
Honey's secret?
{!R}Come, Honey, to my room.\n\nDeep in the basement, Papa is waiting for you...{!W}
Papa's calling me. He's waiting for me in the basement.
Right, to the basement!
Oh! Who are you?
Now, now, relax. I'm not a bad guy.
I can tell you're not a villain.
As a newspaper reporter, I've got my own interest in the international syndicate Panther Claw. Mind if I tag along? Let me help you avenge the doctor!
Seiji Hayami, newspaper reporter! Hahaha! Panther Claw jumped us while I was interviewing the doctor.
Hello there, Honey.
...A robot?
Yes. But not a perfect android like you, Honey.
An android? Honey... isn't human?
Whaaat!?
Your body is something I built with all my genius, my passion and my love.\n\nEvery part of your body, down to each single hair, all of it is the crystallization of my love!
Papa...
Hidden inside Honey's body is the invention of the century: the Airborne Element Fixer!
The Airborne Element Fixer?
A device that instantly combines the elements in the air to create any substance at all. It could even make diamonds without limit.
Hey, did you hear that?
Yeah...!
That is what Panther Claw is after... If the cruel Panther Claw were to take you, Honey...
It's all right, Papa.\n\nThat's why you gave Honey more than human strength, isn't it? I won't lose to villains!
Yes, that's exactly right, Honey.
Go now, Honey.\n\nOnce my robot is destroyed, this laboratory will self-destruct!
So the enemy can never lay hands on a single clue here... Farewell, my eternally beautiful Honey. Farewell...
Come on, we've got to get out of here fast!
Right, let's hurry, Honey!
Goodbye, Papa...
Honey, look at that...!
A black moon...!?
Huh? Oh, you're right. The moon's gone black!?
Whoaaa! Wh-what do we dooo!?
Nooooo!!
...What's wrong with you two?\n\nWhoa!
The Kisaragi mansion exploded, you say?\n\nAnd? What of the Airborne Element Fixer Kisaragi invented?
Well, nothing at all, ma'am... Most likely it went up with the mansion...
Hohoho! Went up with the mansion, you say?
You fool!
The daughter! Dr. Kisaragi's daughter holds the key to his great invention!
Why are you dawdling!?\n\nFind out everything about Dr. Kisaragi's daughter, at once!
Yes, ma'am!
...The Airborne Element Fixer...
That was one big earthquake...
It sure was. Still, I'm glad we ended up in the same place as before the quake.
...What do you mean?
Actually, we...
Actually...
...Whaaat!?\n\nIs that for real? That's pretty hard to swallow...
I hope she's okay...
Pop...!
Your father...?
My old man's name is Danbei. He lives near here.
That quake was really bad, so I'm worried too...\n\nI want to find a way back to the "Hill of Beginnings" too, so let's head down the mountain for now.
Great! The car's in one piece. This is the car I drove up for the interview. C'mon, hop in, hop in!
At this rate, we can't get back to the "Hill of Beginnings"...
She's got Akira-kun with her. They'll both be fine!
Geez, what is this place?\n\nWas there always a ruin like this at the foot of the mountain...?
Isn't there anyone around? Let's find someone and ask.
Hoping for a peaceful life in Kanto now it's gone lawless? Not a chance.
The memory of the Kanto Hellquake is still fresh. Even a little tremor feels like it takes years off my life.
My family's waiting across the sea, torn away from me... You know Kanto got cut off from the rest of Honshu, right?
